title: Database queries slow or timing out
symptoms: Database queries are very slow
Reports and queries time out
Application screens hang waiting on the database
root_cause: Blocking sessions, stale optimizer statistics or a long-running batch job saturating the database.
diagnostic_steps: Check whether the slowness affects all users or a single application
Check active sessions and blocking locks on the database
Review recent changes to queries, indexes or optimizer statistics

steps: Ask the DBA to identify and end the blocking database session
Gather fresh optimizer statistics on the affected tables
Confirm that query response times are back to normal

escalation_criteria: a business-critical close process is blocked

title: Database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: Application cannot obtain a database connection
Intermittent connection errors under load
Queries wait for a free connection
common_error_codes: Cannot get a connection, pool error
root_cause: Connections are leaked or the pool size is too small for the workload.
diagnostic_steps: Check the number of open connections against the pool limit
Check the application logs for connection leak warnings

steps: Restart the application server to release leaked connections
Ask the DBA to review the pool size and session limits
Confirm that new connections are accepted

escalation_criteria: the database refuses all new connections

title: Database login failed or access denied
symptoms: User cannot log in to the database
Login failed when connecting to the reporting database
Access denied or account locked after failed logins
root_cause: The login does not exist, is not mapped to a database user, or the account is locked.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm the exact login error and the database instance name
Check that the login exists and is mapped to a database user
Check whether the account is locked or disabled

steps: Ask the DBA to create the login and map it to the required database role through an approved access request
Unlock the account if it is locked
Ask the user to reconnect and confirm the login succeeds

escalation_criteria: access to restricted data is requested

title: Database password expired
symptoms: Login fails because the database password has expired
User is prompted to change the database password
root_cause: The database password policy forces a change after the expiry period.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm the error message mentions an expired password
Check the password expiry date for the login

steps: Guide the user through the self-service database password change
Ask the user to reconnect with the new password

title: Database backup or restore failure
symptoms: Nightly database backup job failed
Restore of a database backup fails
root_cause: Insufficient backup storage or a locked backup target.
diagnostic_steps: Check the backup job log for the failing step
Check free space on the backup target

steps: Ask the DBA to free space on the backup target and rerun the backup
Confirm the backup completes successfully

escalation_criteria: no valid backup exists for more than 24 hours

title: Laptop overheating or running slowly
symptoms: Laptop is hot and the fan runs constantly
Laptop overheating and shutting down
System becomes very slow under load
root_cause: Blocked air vents, a failing fan or a process keeping the CPU at full load.
diagnostic_steps: Check Task Manager for processes using high CPU
Check that the air vents are not blocked and that the fan is working

steps: Close or update the process that keeps the CPU at full load
Update the BIOS and chipset drivers
Place the laptop on a hard, flat surface and confirm the temperature drops

title: External monitor flickers or goes black
symptoms: External monitor goes black intermittently
Monitor blacks out after a driver or Windows update
Display flickers or shows no signal
root_cause: A faulty video cable, an incompatible display driver or an unsupported refresh rate.
diagnostic_steps: Check and reseat the video cable or try a different cable
Check whether the problem started after a display driver or Windows update
Check the refresh rate and resolution settings of the monitor

steps: Roll back or update the display driver
Set the refresh rate to the value supported by the monitor
Confirm the monitor stays on for 30 minutes

title: Docking station peripherals not detected
symptoms: Peripherals connected to the docking station are not detected
Dock does not charge the laptop
root_cause: Outdated dock firmware or a faulty dock power supply.
diagnostic_steps: Check the dock power supply and connection
Check the dock firmware version

steps: Update the docking station firmware
Reconnect the dock and confirm the peripherals are detected

title: Keyboard or mouse not responding
symptoms: Keyboard does not respond
Mouse pointer does not move
Wireless mouse or keyboard disconnects
root_cause: Low batteries, a faulty receiver or a driver problem.
diagnostic_steps: Check the batteries and the USB receiver
Try a different USB port

steps: Replace the batteries or the receiver
Reinstall the input device driver
Confirm the device responds

title: Internal application access request
symptoms: User needs access to an internal application
User sees an access denied page in the intranet application
root_cause: The user is not a member of the application's access group.
diagnostic_steps: Confirm which application and role the user needs

steps: Raise an access request for the application role with manager approval
Confirm the user can open the application

escalation_criteria: access to restricted data is requested

title: VPN will not connect or repeatedly disconnects
symptoms: VPN client cannot connect from home
VPN connection drops every few minutes
VPN disconnects repeatedly and the session is lost
common_error_codes: The connection was terminated by the remote computer
root_cause: The assigned VPN gateway is unreachable or the VPN client version is outdated.
diagnostic_steps: Check internet connectivity without the VPN
Restart the VPN client
Check that the VPN client is the current approved version
Test the connection to an alternate VPN gateway

steps: Connect to the alternate VPN gateway listed in the client profile
Reinstall the approved VPN client version
Confirm the VPN stays connected for 15 minutes

title: VPN slow or unstable performance
symptoms: VPN is connected but very slow
VPN performance is unstable on a busy laptop
root_cause: Local resource exhaustion or a congested home connection.
diagnostic_steps: Check endpoint CPU and memory usage while connected to the VPN
Run a speed test with and without the VPN

steps: Close resource-heavy applications while on the VPN
Switch to a wired home connection and confirm performance

title: Cannot connect to corporate Wi-Fi
symptoms: Laptop cannot join the corporate Wi-Fi network
Wi-Fi authentication fails
root_cause: An expired device certificate or a wrong network profile.
diagnostic_steps: Check that the device certificate is valid
Check that the correct SSID profile is installed

steps: Renew the device certificate through the device management portal
Reconnect to the corporate SSID

title: Wi-Fi drops intermittently
symptoms: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Laptops lose the wireless connection on one floor
Wireless keeps disconnecting
root_cause: Weak access-point coverage, channel interference or an outdated wireless driver.
diagnostic_steps: Check the Wi-Fi signal strength at the user's location
Check whether other devices on the same floor are affected
Check the wireless adapter driver version

steps: Forget and rejoin the corporate wireless network
Update the wireless network adapter driver
Confirm the Wi-Fi connection stays up for 30 minutes

title: DNS name resolution failures
symptoms: Internal websites cannot be resolved by name
Server names do not resolve but IP addresses work
root_cause: Stale DNS cache or a wrong DNS server assigned to the client.
diagnostic_steps: Check name resolution with nslookup
Check which DNS servers the client uses

steps: Flush the local DNS cache
Renew the network configuration and confirm names resolve

escalation_criteria: the DNS server is unreachable for many users

title: Antivirus quarantine or threat alert
symptoms: Antivirus quarantined a file
Antivirus shows a threat alert
root_cause: The endpoint protection engine flagged a file as malicious or suspicious.
diagnostic_steps: Record the threat name and the file path from the alert
Check whether other devices reported the same threat

steps: Run a full scan with the endpoint protection tool
Report the alert to the security operations team

title: Application crashes on launch
symptoms: Application crashes immediately on startup
Outlook closes unexpectedly when opened
Application stops working with an access violation
root_cause: A corrupted profile, a faulty add-in or damaged application files.
diagnostic_steps: Start the application in safe mode
Check Event Viewer for the faulting module
Check recently installed add-ins

steps: Repair the Office installation from Programs and Features
Create a new Outlook profile
Confirm the application starts normally

escalation_criteria: the crash continues after a repair

title: Application slow or high CPU usage
symptoms: Application uses high CPU
Computer fan is loud and CPU usage is at 100%
Laptop gets hot and slow while running applications
root_cause: A runaway process or an outdated application build consuming CPU.
diagnostic_steps: Check Task Manager for the process using the most CPU
Check for pending application updates

steps: End the runaway process and restart the application
Apply the latest application update
Confirm CPU usage returns to normal

escalation_criteria: CPU usage stays high after updates
